Ws(lambda) supplies each traditional merge-point time in the path-weighted sum.

Traditional path probabilities and arrival rates define WMT.
Ws(lambda) supplies downstream and pre-merge cellular time.
WT and mu0 supply toll and direct-path components of cellular total time.
